text:
incident-bot: PAGER: ap-east1 GPU pool at 98% and autoscaler failing to provision GPUs (InsufficientResource). Queue growth sustained >90% for 7m. Severity: P2. Paging @oncall. Link: <https://redwood/ops/incidents/INC-4123> :rotating_light:

jamal: I'm taking this. oncall here, pinging infra and SRE. quick read: are we seeing quota errors from the cloud or actual physical capacity?

emily: logs show repeated provisioning errors from GCP: 'Quota exceeded for resource 'GPUS' in region ap-east1'. Autoscaler tries to create nodes but API returns 403-like quota response. Queued requests ~11.2k, tokenized jobs backing up.

liam: Can confirm from autoscaler events:
```
Event: FailedCreate
Reason: InsufficientResource
Message: The zone does not have enough resources available to fulfill the request.
QuotaError: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region 'asia-east1'
```

jamal: ok — two parallel paths: 1) immediate customer mitigation (reroute/fallback) 2) cloud escalation for quota bump or temporary allocation. Emily, can you open the GCP case and paste case id here? Liam, start a manual scale attempt to validate same error.

emily: Case opened: https://console.cloudsupport.google.com/cases/CASE-984321 - asked for emergency regional quota increase and allocation. Included our workload link and latency delta.

liam: Manual scale attempt output:
```
$ gcloud compute instances create-with-container gpu-node-try --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --zone=asia-east1-a
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create_with_container) Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Available: 0, Requested: 1
```

opsbot: Started routing canary: route-rule add --from-region ap-east1 --to-region us-central1 --weight 0.5 (canary for new requests). CI: rolling. :gear:

jamal: Good. Rolling to 100% if metrics look okay. Also enable fallback model profile for non-enterprise customers to a smaller quantized variant to reduce GPU footprint by ~3x. Sarah, can you confirm customer impact and who needs direct comms?

sarah-ng: Customer impact: two mid-market customers (acme-ml, dataflowlabs) are experiencing 503s for batch endpoints and elevated latency on chat endpoints. Enterprise customers on Dedicated are unaffected. Posting on status page and triggering direct 1:1 notif for acme-ml. Status draft: "We're experiencing capacity constraints in ap-east1 affecting inference jobs; we're rerouting traffic and working with GCP for a quota increase."

jamal: Emily — post that status update and include the case link. Also, set routing weight to 0.0 for ap-east1 if latency doesn't improve in 6m.

emily: Status updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-4123 - added note about mitigation steps and ETA for next update in 20 minutes.

liam: After canary (50%) we saw queue drop ~58% in 4m and CPU/GPU utilization in us-central1 increased appropriately. But new requests from ap-east1 still get queued at edge until router config fully propagates.

jamal: Good. Next steps: 1) set ap-east1 weight -> 0.0 now 2) continue cloud support push for quota bump 3) enable preemption reclaim on low-priority pools and drain noncritical batches 4) monitor error budgets and customer SLAs. I will also open an internal change to prioritize smaller-quant models for background jobs until capacity restores.

opsbot: Routing weight change applied: ap-east1 -> 0.0. Canary removed. :white_check_mark:

emily: GCP responded: looking into case CASE-984321; asked for quota increase justification. They've flagged it as P0 for review. Estimated time to decision: 1-3 hours but may be faster. We also requested temporary allocation for 24h.

liam: After full reroute and fallback profiles, overall queued requests down to 2.7k and user-facing 5xxs decreased by ~86%. latencies on critical paths back within SLO for most customers.

sarah-ng: I've messaged acme-ml support lead with the current mitigation steps and ETA. They're okay with reroute but want to be notified when we restore ap-east1.

jamal: marking incident status: active -> mitigated (partial). Continuing to monitor and chase GCP. If allocation granted, we'll gradually restore ap-east1 traffic and remove fallback. Assign follow-ups: 1) liam - postmortem runbook + quota mitigations 2) emily - customer comms + update status page 3) infra - consider increasing reserved pool in ap-east1 for hard SLO customers.

statuspage-bot: Incident INC-4123 updated: State=Mitigated (partial). Next update scheduled in 30m.

incident-bot: Note: runbook tag applied: gpu-quota-regional -> follow up with cloud provider checklists and permanent routing policy to avoid single-region exposure.

jamal: Thanks team. I'll keep this thread as primary incident log. If GCP provides allocation earlier we'll reopen for traffic restore steps. :thumbsup:
